title: Your first Omega program: hello, compile, run, exit status
summary: Drake's first Omega program is a text and one write call, compiled by the seeded compiler omc into a static AArch64 Linux program with no libc underneath. I'll show you the routine he uses every time: check the compiler hash, compile, read the compile status, run only a clean build, then read the exit status. main's value modulo 256 is the status; a trap exits 100 plus its code.
goal: Compile and run a hello-world .om program with the pinned omc and read both the compile status and the run status.
key_steps: Check sha256 of seed/out/omc against the pin
Write a text and a fn main that binds the result of write
Compile with omc < hello.om > hello and read the compile status
Run the program only if the compile returned 0
Read the run status: main value modulo 256, or 100 plus a trap code

example.code:
note hello.om: the smallest useful Omega program
text msg "hello from seeded Omega\n"
fn main to int
w = write 1 msg 0 len msg
if ne w long len msg
ret 1
end
ret 0
end
example.command: Read examples/omega-01-hello-world/POINTER.md. Recorded host output: examples/omega-01-hello-world/output.txt.
example.output:
omc sha256 befb8199db8c4bca188a494dfaac2a6f0ee5c36fcea11188c75666c55fce8a1d
== 1. hello: compile, then run only if the compile returned 0
compile hello.om rc=0
hello from seeded Omega
run rc=0
== 2. the exit status is main's value modulo 256
compile status.om rc=0
run rc=44
== 3. negative control: a result that is not bound to a name
compile unbound.om rc=16
omc: line 4: error 16
RESULT PASS

common_mistake: Calling write as a bare statement. It returns a long (bytes written or minus errno), so it must be bound and checked: w = write 1 msg 0 len msg. At this pin the bare write line is refused with error 16; a bare call to your own value-returning function is error 7.

evidence_note: Compiled and run on a Linux AArch64 host with omc sha256 befb8199...8a1d at omega-mv 19f014f2; output reproduced byte for byte on a second run. Not hardware qualification; no other OS or ISA was run.
